our_title: Graph loaders trust unbounded header counts, label values and HB field widths (overflow / huge alloc / hang)
ran: Mutation fuzzer (fuzz/tools/mutfuzz.py, seed 42, 2264 iters) on patched 32-bit ASan+UBSan build. Examples: chac '2147483647 2 000' -> memAllocGroup requested 0xfffffffe00000008 (ASan); mtx '4 4 -1' -> malloc 0xfffffffffffffff8; grf label 2147483647 -> UBSan 'vlblmax + 1' overflow at graph_io.c:306 then ~8GB indxtab alloc; rsa format '(1X,10I999999)' -> UBSan at habo:270 and near-hang on '(10I9999999999)'.
evidence: Chaco: 'grafptr->vertnbr = chavertnbr; grafptr->edgenbr = chaedgenbr * 2;' with no sign/range check. Mmkt: 'memAlloc (2 * linenbr * sizeof ...)' with linenbr unchecked. graph_io.c:297 'memAlloc ((vlblmax + 1) * sizeof (Gnum))' where vlblmax can reach GNUMMAX. HB format: 'number = number * 10 + *charptr - '0';' with no width bound, used as a getc loop count.

fix_options.label: Reject non-positive header object counts
fix_options.summary: Add chavertnbr/chaedgenbr and mrownbr/linenbr >= 0 checks, mirroring graphLoad's header checks.
fix_options.tested: untested: not built. Closes the negative-count wrapped-alloc cases; does not bound large positive counts.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Cheap and matches precedent; a negative count already fails allocation gracefully in production, so this is clarity/DoS hardening, not a corruption fix.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Matches graph_io.c:131-139; but whether to add it (and any upper bound / HB width bound) is the maintainer's call.

fix_options.label: Overflow-safe integer parsing and field-width bounds
fix_options.summary: Detect overflow in intLoad()/graphGeomLoadHaboFormat() accumulation and cap HB field widths to the 80-column line.
fix_options.tested: untested: design decision. intLoad() is common_integer.c, shared by every loader and outside this group's files.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Removes the UBSan overflows and the format-width hang class, but touches common code and needs an agreed bound.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Belongs with the common I/O layer; flagged for the maintainer / common-code owners.

our_title: graphLoad accepted negative vertex degrees and could overflow the arc-count accumulator
ran: Fuzzer on pristine ASan+UBSan: grf with degree 2147483647 -> UBSan 'signed integer overflow: 6 + 2147483647' at graph_io.c:224 ('degrval += edgenum'). A negative degree was silently treated as an isolated vertex. Fixed by patch 0001 (reject degrval<0; test 'degrval > edgennd - edgenum' before adding).
evidence: 7.0.17: 'if (intLoad (stream, &degrval) != 1)' with no degrval<0 check, then 'degrval += edgenum; if (degrval > edgennd)' - the addition overflows before the test.

fix_options.label: Reject negative degree and test overflow before adding (recommended, committed)
fix_options.summary: Add (degrval < 0); replace 'degrval += edgenum; if (degrval > edgennd)' with 'if (degrval > edgennd - edgenum)' then add.
fix_options.tested: Built 32/64-bit (0 warnings); the UBSan hit is gone; valid graphs load; all listed check targets pass.
fix_options.tradeoffs: None; folded into the GRA-04/GRA-10 commit as part of one coherent read-loop validation.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Same spirit as febaef7's edloval<1 check; the twin dgraphLoadDist/Cent accumulators (dgraph_io_load.c, G20) have the same pattern and should get the same fix.
